summary: Innoviz Technologies filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Yoav Har-Even as Chairperson of the Board, effective immediately, following Amichai Steimberg's voluntary decision to step down; Steimberg remains a board member. Har-Even, a former President and CEO of Rafael Advanced Defense Systems and retired IDF Major General, joined the board in July 2026. The routine board leadership change reflects strategic focus on defense markets. No financial terms, advisors, or transaction mechanics are involved. Watch for continued board stability and strategic execution in defense and homeland security.
